# netactuate_vpc_nameservers (Resource)

Manages a VPC Nameservers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_vpc_nameservers" "example" {
  vpc_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID whose DHCP nameservers are managed.

### Optional

- `ipv4` (List of String) IPv4 nameservers announced by DHCP.
- `ipv6` (List of String) IPv6 nameservers announced by DHCP.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_vpc_nameservers.example 12345
```
